Loopback to spec-writer: Missing capability documentation (docs/CHECKS-GATE.md): The spec requires 'docs updated in the style of the existing capability docs'. Other features (memory-gate, supervisor, design-system) have docs/[FEATURE].md files. The checks-gate needs similar documentation explaining purpose, configuration, and behavior.; Missing CHANGELOG.md update: The spec requires 'CHANGELOG Unreleased updated'. The Unreleased section was not modified to include the checks-gate feature. Other features have entries in CHANGELOG.md describing their capabilities (design systems, verified memory gate, bounded supervisor).; Gate logic belongs in anvil/gates.py, not inline in runner.py: The functions _run_checks_gate() and _get_changed_files() (177 lines) are defined directly in anvil/runner.py, but ARCHITECTURE.md documents that 'Gate layer: anvil/gates.py and anvil/approver.py are deterministic.' All other gates (spec_gate, tdd_gate, review_gate, human_gate) live in anvil/gates.py as pure functions. Extract the checks gate evaluation logic into anvil/gates.py as checks_gate(phase, base_ref_config, changed_files, project_dir, work_order_id, timeout) -> dict, keeping only the orchestration logic in runner.py.; Station kind 'gate' is undocumented: stations/checks-gate/station.json uses kind: 'gate', but ARCHITECTURE.md only documents 'agent' and 'deterministic' as station kinds. Other deterministic stations (approver, intake, triage-human) use kind: 'deterministic'. Either use kind: 'deterministic' consistently, or document what 'gate' means and why it differs from 'deterministic'.; Protected paths default includes 'anvil.json' but should include the entire checks configuration path: The spec states 'Protected paths default to the checks configuration itself and the project's tests directory'. Line 111 in runner.py hardcodes protected_paths = ['tests/', 'anvil.json'], but this assumes the checks config is always in anvil.json. A project could configure checks elsewhere. The default should reference 'the checks configuration file path' generically, or the requirement should be clarified in the spec.; No interface output present in this feature. The checks gate implementation is purely backend infrastructure (Python runner code, configuration, and tests) with no HTML, React components, CSS, or user-facing pages to review against the design system.
